evidence: efficiency 2.47 at cost 0.09, dTFR +0.22 (bends); tops all 12 levers

claim: a full recovery bundle ablates to a lean 3-lever efficient core keeping ~the full gain
evidence: core ['inequality compression', 'gender-equity (domestic)', 'cohabitation legal recognition'] cost 0.69 keeps dTFR +1.28 vs full cost 2.56

claim: coupling is non-ablatable; cash/quant deliver ~zero improvement per cost (the mirage on the cost axis)
the same harbinger buys more improvement the earlier it fires (momentum)
evidence: gender-equity dTFR +0.45 early vs +0.23 a generation late

claim: the cost-vs-improvement Pareto frontier has a low-cost knee at the cheap coupling combos
evidence: frontier rises steeply then flattens; knee at cost ~0.28
